S/RES/2833 (2026) · 2026-10-30

UN Security Council Resolution 2833 (2026)

Extension of the mandate of the UN Verification Mission in Colombia until 31 Oct. 2027

Ukraine and fragmentation · Americas

Unanimous
Yes 15No 0Abstained 0
Women, peace and securityChildren and armed conflictSexual violence

Official document (PDF) · Draft S/2026/857 · Meeting record S/PV.10257

United Nations S/RES/2833 (2026) Security Council Distr.: General 30 October 2026 Resolution 2833 (2026) Adopted by the Security Council at its 10257th meeting , on 30 October 2026 The Security Council , Reaffirming its commitment to supporting Colombia in establishing peace, justice and security, Recognising the people of the Republic of Colombia’s constitutional commitment to the peace process and recalling its relevant resolutions, Welcoming progress made towards peace in Colombia, recognising the ongoing challenges in Colombia in this regard, recalling the efforts since the adoption of the 2016 Final Peace Agreement for Ending the Conflict and Building a Stable and Lasting Peace (the Final Agreement), recalling also the efforts in tackling structural factors underlying the conflict, commending notable efforts to date in this respect by the security forces and civil society including women and youth, urging greater efforts from relevant state institutions, and encouraging all stakeholders to work together to build on efforts to date and address ongoing challenges, Noting in particular the continued violence in conflict-affected areas which affects all communities, including sexual violence and gender-based violence targeting women and girls, and recalling the disproportionate impact of the conflict on all vulnerable communities including women, children and persons belonging to marginalised communities, Recognising the changing conflict dynamics in Colombia and stressing the importance of strengthening the State’s presence and territorial development across conflict affected regions, including through the implementation of the Final Agreement and complementary security policies and efforts to address illicit drug production and trafficking and illegal mining, Recognising the Government’s commitment to recovering the State’s territorial control and to build the State’s presence across the territories and underlining the importance of the UN Verification Mission’s field presence particularly in conflict-affected regions to support engagement with authorities and these communities, Reaffirming Colombia’s sovereign ownership of the implementation of the Final Agreement,

1. Decides to extend the mandate of the Verification Mission in Colombia until 31 October 2027, focusing on its primary function to support verification and monitoring of implementation of the Final Agreement pertaining to resolution 2366 (2017) ;

2. Requests the Secretary-General to ensure coordination and efficiencies, including by ensuring that other activities in country are carried out by the most appropriate UN system entity;

3. Expresses its willingness to continue working with Colombia.
